assignmentHtml.task:
研究 Apache Doris 和 StarRocks 的架构。针对每一个系统，调查：

  1. 数据摄取——Kafka 连接器、CDC（Debezium）、直接加载、批处理。
  2. 更新与删除——唯一键模型、主键模型、部分更新、删除标记、迟到事件处理、水位线。
  3. 连接——无共享 MPP、向量化引擎，以及与 Iceberg/Hudi/Delta 的连接。
  4. 多租户——资源组、标签、隔离。
  5. 恢复——高可用性、Follower 读取，以及回滚会恢复哪些内容。
  6. 许可证——两者都是 Apache 2.0 吗？StarRocks 双重许可。
  7. 版本注意事项，尤其是 Iceberg 集成和 CDC 合并引擎相关事项。
    它们属于服务层，还是也承担数据转换？
assignmentHtml.context: 证据截止日期为 2026-09-16。开源分析平台设计调研。Doris 和 StarRocks 都是候选系统。需求包括基于 CDC 的可变订单、Iceberg 数据湖连接、多租户报表、擦除，以及在最多 3 个有状态组件的限制下进行恢复。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 为 Apache Doris 和 StarRocks 提供结构化调研档案，涵盖架构、数据摄取、更新与删除、连接、数据湖互操作性、隔离、恢复、许可证、版本注意事项，并附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
COMPREHENSIVE DOSSIER: Apache Doris vs StarRocks Architectures

=== APACHE DORIS ===

ARCHITECTURE:

  • Shared-nothing MPP: FE plans queries as DAG of PlanFragments; BEs execute against local tablets. Three stacked layers: MPP (cross-BE coordination), Pipeline Engine (per-BE operator scheduling), Vectorized Execution (column-batch inner loops). Nereids CBO optimizer. BDB JE for metadata. Paxos-like consensus among Master/Follower/Observer FEs. 3-replica default with quorum writes.
    Sources: https://doris.apache.org/docs/4.x/key-features/mpp/, https://doris.apache.org/docs/dev/features-architecture/system-architecture/

INGESTION:

  • Routine Load: FE-managed Kafka consumer; batches turned into transactional loads
  • Flink Doris Connector + Flink CDC: whole-database sync, exactly-once via Stream Load 2PC
  • Doris Kafka Connector: Kafka Connect sink plugin for Avro/Protobuf/Debezium payloads
  • Stream Load (HTTP, 2PC), Broker Load, Spark Load
  • All paths land in Unique Key Merge-on-Write tables; out-of-order handling via sequence_col
    Sources: https://doris.apache.org/docs/dev/key-features/kafka-cdc-integration/

UPDATES/DELETES:

  • Unique Key model = primary key table. Default since 2.1 is Merge-on-Write (MoW): duplicates resolved at write time via delete bitmaps
  • Late events/out-of-order: function_column.sequence_col — larger value wins; equal values fall back to load order. Protects against delayed CDC events
  • DORIS_DELETE_SIGN: hidden tinyint column, set to 1 for soft deletes on any load path
  • Partial column update: only writes specified columns, reads rest from existing row (requires MoW)
  • DELETE FROM ... WHERE: same MoW flow without new rowset; on Duplicate/Aggregate tables records predicate in tablet metadata, applied at read time
  • Primary keys cannot be rewritten; use soft-delete + insert
    Sources: https://doris.apache.org/docs/4.x/key-features/unique-key/, https://doris.apache.org/docs/dev/key-features/data-update-delete/, https://doris.apache.org/docs/dev/table-design/data-model/merge-on-write/

JOINS / LAKE INTEROP:

  • Shared-nothing MPP joins: Broadcast, Shuffle, Bucket Shuffle, Colocate Join
  • Iceberg: FULL engine (not just reader). 7 catalog backends (REST, HMS, Glue, S3 Tables, JDBC, DLF, Hadoop). Read+write V1-V3. DML (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE INTO) requires format version 2+. Deletion vectors (Puffin/V3) since 4.1. Time travel, branches/tags. Federated joins between Iceberg and Doris tables as single MPP plan
  • Hudi: READ-ONLY. COW snapshot queries, MOR snapshot/read-optimized, time travel, incremental read via @incr. Dependent Hudi version 0.15. No Hudi writes
  • Delta Lake: experimental since 3.0.1 via Trino connector compatibility. Read-only (no write-back). Supports data integration (read Delta → write Doris)
    Sources: https://doris.apache.org/docs/dev/key-features/iceberg/, https://doris.apache.org/docs/dev/lakehouse/best-practices/doris-hudi/, https://doris.apache.org/docs/3.x/lakehouse/catalogs/delta-lake-catalog/, https://www.velodb.io/blog/apache-doris-4-1-on-iceberg-v3-full-lakehouse-lifecycle

MULTI-TENANT:

  • Resource Group: physical isolation via resource tags. Each BE gets one tag (tag.location); replicas allocated per tag via replication_allocation; users bound to tags via resource_tags.location. Query planner restricts to user's allowed tag BEs. One replica per pool per shared table = storage cost
  • Workload Group: in-process CPU (cgroups), memory, IO, concurrency isolation. Per-FE queues. Bind users via SET PROPERTY
  • Compute Group: for storage-compute decoupled mode
    Sources: https://doris.apache.org/docs/dev/key-features/resource-group/, https://doris.apache.org/docs/dev/key-features/workload-group/

RECOVERY:

  • FE HA: Master/Follower/Observer roles. Paxos-like consensus. Follower FEs read metadata and participate in elections. When Master fails, followers elect new Master transparently
  • Data HA: 3 replicas default, quorum writes, automatic fault isolation, automatic replica rebuild from healthy replicas
  • RECOVER: restores deleted databases/tables/partitions from recycle bin (default retention 1 day, configurable via catalog_trash_expire_second)
  • RESTORE: full backup snapshots including metadata AND data; database/table/partition granularity
  • Follower FEs serve read queries (metadata read + query concurrency)
  • No "rollback" of data changes within tables; use DORIS_DELETE_SIGN soft deletes or partition replace
    Sources: https://doris.apache.org/docs/dev/features-architecture/system-architecture/, https://doris.apache.org/docs/4.x/admin-manual/data-admin/backup-restore/restore/, https://doris.apache.org/docs/2.1/sql-manual/sql-statements/recycle/RECOVER/

LICENSE:

  • Apache License 2.0 (Apache Software Foundation project). Fully open source. No dual/commercial license tier
    Sources: https://github.com/apache/doris/blob/master/LICENSE.txt, https://doris.apache.org/community/join-community/

VERSION CAVEATS:

  • Iceberg V3 (deletion vectors, row lineage) requires Doris 4.1.0+; MERGE INTO and Row Lineage are EXPERIMENTAL
  • Iceberg DML requires format-version >= 2 (V1 tables must be upgraded)
  • Iceberg V3 writes at table creation; migration from V2 via ALTER TABLE SET PROPERTIES ('format-version' = '3')
  • AWS Glue/DLF catalogs support reads only; REST catalogs recommended for V3
  • Hudi: dependent version 0.15, recommended 0.14+. Read-only. Incremental reads via JNI may require JVM flag
  • Delta Lake: experimental since 3.0.1, read-only, uses Trino connector v435
    Sources: https://doris.apache.org/docs/dev/lakehouse/catalogs/iceberg-catalog/, https://www.velodb.io/blog/apache-doris-4-1-on-iceberg-v3-full-lakehouse-lifecycle

Serving-layer vs Transformation: BOTH are serving-layer AND transformation-capable. They ingest real-time streams, transform via SQL (CTAS, INSERT INTO, materialized views), and serve low-latency analytics. ELT pattern fully supported.

=== STARROCKS ===

ARCHITECTURE:

  • Shared-nothing MPP (also supports shared-data/disaggregated mode). FE: metadata management (BDB JE), query planning, leader election via Raft among leader/followers/observers. BE: data storage + SQL execution on local disks. Fully vectorized execution engine. Multi-replica strategy for availability.
    Sources: https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/introduction/Architecture/

INGESTION:

  • StarRocks Kafka Connector: self-developed sink connector, at-least-once semantics. Supports Protobuf (unlike Routine Load). Debezium CDC loading supported since v1.0.1 (Nov 2023) via transforms: AddOpFieldForDebeziumRecord + ExtractNewRecordState (drop tombstones, rewrite deletes)
  • Routine Load: CSV, JSON, AVRO natively; Debezium needs transforms
  • Stream Load, Broker Load, Flink CDC
  • Primary Key tables are target for CDC upserts
    Sources: https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/loading/kafka/Kafka-connector-starrocks/, https://docs.starrocks.io/releasenotes/kafka_connector/

UPDATES/DELETES:

  • Primary Key table: Delete+Insert strategy using DelVector. Updates mark old row deleted + write new row to new file; deletes mark in DelVector. Primary key index updated. Queries read only latest version — no merge at read time (3-10x faster than Unique Key MoR)
  • __op field: defaults to UPSERT; set to DELETE for deletes; mixed 0/1 in data column
  • Partial updates: partial_update=true, row mode (many columns, small batches) and column mode (few columns, large batches). Missing rows inserted with defaults
  • Conditional updates (merge_condition): non-PK column as condition; updates only when incoming >= existing. Designed to resolve data disorder/late events. Available since v2.5; partial+conditional combined since v3.1.3
  • Primary key values cannot be updated
    Sources: https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/table_design/table_types/primary_key_table/, https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/loading/Load_to_Primary_Key_tables/

JOINS / LAKE INTEROP:

  • Shared-nothing MPP + vectorized engine. Joins between internal tables and lake tables via external catalogs
  • Iceberg: external catalog since v2.4. READ + INSERT INTO (from v3.1). Parquet: V1 supported; V2 position deletes from v3.1, equality deletes from v3.1.10/3.2.5/3.3+. ORC: V2 position deletes from v3.0, equality deletes from v3.1.8/3.2.3/3.3+. Iceberg views on REST from v3.3.2. Metadata tables from v3.4.1. Time Travel from v3.4.0. NOTABLE: Iceberg V3 (deletion vectors) NOT SUPPORTED (issue #63819). UPDATE statement on Iceberg V2 tables not supported (issue #72046)
  • Hudi: external catalog since v2.4. Complete COW + MOR support (Parquet only). Read + INSERT INTO. Hudi 0.15.0 explicit support in v3.5.0
  • Delta Lake: external catalog since v2.5. Read + INSERT INTO. Features: V2 Checkpoint v3.3.0+, timestamp_ntz v3.3.1+, column mapping v3.3.6+, deletion vectors v3.4.1+. No writes TO Delta Lake
    Sources: https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/data_source/catalog/iceberg/, https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/data_source/catalog/hudi_catalog/, https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/data_source/catalog/deltalake_catalog/, https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/data_source/feature-support-data-lake-analytics/

MULTI-TENANT:

  • Resource Group: per-BE resource sets with CPU weights (soft) or exclusive cores/percent (hard isolation since v3.3.5). Memory via mem_limit/mem_pool. Concurrency limits. Classifiers route queries by user/role/query_type/source_ip/db/plan costs. default_wg and default_mv_wg system groups
  • BE Labels: tag BEs (e.g., location), place table replicas on labeled BEs, bind users to labels. For data placement/isolation
    Sources: https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/administration/management/resource_management/resource_group/, https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/administration/management/resource_management/be_label/

RECOVERY:

  • FE HA: leader/follower/observer roles. Raft-based leader election. Majority of Followers required for service. Observer FEs extend read concurrency (queries automatically routed to observers)
  • Follower FEs: read metadata, replay logs from leader, participate in elections. Can serve read queries
  • Metadata recovery: metadata_ignore_unknown_operation_type=true for downgrade compatibility; metadata_enable_recovery_mode=true for damaged metadata; last-resort bdbje_reset_election_group=true forcing node with latest metadata (largest lastVLSN) as leader
  • Snapshot-based disaster recovery for shared-data architecture (v3.5+)
  • No equivalent to Doris's RECOVER (recycle bin) or table-level rollback
    Sources: https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/administration/Meta_recovery/, https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/administration/management/Scale_up_down/, https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/faq/operation_maintenance_faq/

LICENSE:

  • Apache License 2.0. FULLY OPEN SOURCE. No dual license, no commercial source-available tier. Commercial offerings (StarRocks Cloud, enterprise support plans) are managed services, not a separate license. Governance: LF Projects LLC
    Sources: https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/blob/main/LICENSE.txt, https://www.starrocks.io/product/vendors/index.html, https://www.starrocks.io/index.html

VERSION CAVEATS:

  • Iceberg V3 deletion vectors NOT supported (as of latest docs/issues)
  • Iceberg UPDATE on V2 tables NOT supported (INSERT/DELETE work)
  • Iceberg equality deletes require v3.1.10/3.2.5/3.3+ (Parquet); v3.1.8/3.2.3/3.3+ (ORC)
  • Do NOT downgrade from v3.3 directly to v3.2.0/3.2.1/3.2.2 (metadata loss); v4.0 → v3.5.0/3.5.1 incompatible
  • Hudi catalog from v2.4; Hudi 0.15.0 explicit in v3.5.0
  • Delta Lake features staggered across v3.3-v3.4
    Sources: https://docs.starrocks.io/docs/data_source/catalog/iceberg/, https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/issues/63819, https://github.com/StarRocks/starrocks/issues/72046, https://docs.starrocks.io/releasenotes/release-3.3/

Serving-layer vs Transformation: BOTH serve as real-time serving layer (sub-second queries, high concurrency) AND transformation engine (SQL ELT, materialized views, async MV refresh). StarRocks specifically markets itself as both data warehouse and lakehouse query engine.

=== KEY DIFFERENCES FOR YOUR REQUIREMENTS ===

  1. CDC-based mutable orders: Both support. Doris uses sequence_col; StarRocks uses merge_condition
  2. Iceberg lake joins: Doris has fuller DML support (including V3). StarRocks supports read + INSERT INTO but lacks V3 and Iceberg UPDATE
  3. Multi-tenant reporting: Both have resource groups + labels
  4. Erasure coding: Neither documented as first-class; both rely on multi-replica (3x storage). Check specific version docs
  5. Recovery within 3-stateful-component limit: Both have 3-FE HA (Raft/Paxos). StarRocks Follower FEs serve reads; Observer extends concurrency. Doris Follower FEs serve reads
  6. License: Both Apache 2.0. StarRocks has NO dual license — it is purely OSS with commercial cloud services only

evidence.snippet: Doris ingests Kafka topics and CDC change streams natively through three paths: Routine Load (FE-managed Kafka consumer), Flink Doris Connector with Flink CDC (exactly-once via Stream Load 2PC), and Doris Kafka Connector (Kafka Connect sink for Avro/Protobuf/Debezium). All paths land in Unique Key MoW tables with out-of-order handling via function_column.sequence_col.
evidence.supports: Doris ingestion paths including Debezium CDC, and late-event handling via sequence column

evidence.snippet: Unique Key model keeps exactly one row per primary key, enforced at write time by Merge-on-Write (default since 2.1). function_column.sequence_col decides which write wins when two updates carry the same key. __DORIS_DELETE_SIGN__ is a hidden tinyint column set to 1 to soft-delete a row through any load path. Partial-column upserts read the rest from existing row.
evidence.supports: Doris unique key model, sequence column for late events, delete sign, partial updates

evidence.snippet: Merge-on-write resolves duplicates at write time via delete bitmap; merge-on-read appends and merges at query time. Implementation fixed at table creation, cannot change later. Partial column update requires merge-on-write. Default is merge-on-write.
evidence.supports: Doris MoW vs MoR distinction, fixed at creation, partial updates require MoW

evidence.snippet: Apache Doris is a full Apache Iceberg engine. Seven catalog backends (REST, HMS, Glue, S3 Tables, JDBC, DLF, Hadoop). Reads V1-V3, writes V2 by default. V3 writes (deletion vectors/Puffin) require 4.1+. Federated joins with lake tables run as one MPP plan. Row-level DML needs format version 2 or 3. Hudi writes not supported — Doris is a Hudi reader today.
evidence.supports: Doris full Iceberg engine with version caveats, Hudi read-only

evidence.snippet: Delta Lake Catalog uses Trino Connector compatibility framework. Supported since version 3.0.1 (experimental). Data Integration: read Delta Lake and write to Doris internal tables. Data Write-back: Not supported.
evidence.supports: Doris Delta Lake read-only, experimental since 3.0.1

evidence.snippet: Resource Group is placement-and-routing based on resource tags. Every BE belongs to exactly one location tag. Replicas allocated per tag via replication_allocation. Users bound to tags via resource_tags.location. Query planner picks BEs in user's tag set. Physical isolation — a BE crash in one group does not affect others.
evidence.supports: Doris physical multi-tenant isolation via tags/labels

evidence.snippet: Workload Group is in-process resource isolation partitioning CPU (cgroups), memory, IO, and concurrency across query groups. Bind users via SET PROPERTY. max_concurrency, max_queue_size per group.
evidence.supports: Doris logical/multi-tenant workload isolation

evidence.snippet: FE roles: Master (writes metadata), Follower (reads metadata, participates in election), Observer (reads metadata, extends query concurrency). Paxos-like consensus. 3 replicas default, majority confirmation for writes. Automatic fault isolation and replica rebuild. RECOVER statement restores deleted databases/tables/partitions from recycle bin (default 1-day retention). RESTORE brings back backup snapshots with metadata and data.
evidence.supports: Doris HA, follower reads, RECOVER and RESTORE semantics

evidence.snippet: Apache License Version 2.0. No dual license or commercial edition found.
evidence.supports: Doris is Apache 2.0 only

evidence.snippet: RECOVER restores previously deleted databases, tables, or partitions. Default retention 1 day, configurable via catalog_trash_expire_second in fe.conf. Supports renaming on recover.
evidence.supports: What Doris RECOVER/rollback restores: deleted metadata objects

evidence.snippet: StarRocks Kafka connector is a sink connector with at-least-once semantics. Debezium CDC loading requires transforms: AddOpFieldForDebeziumRecord and ExtractNewRecordState with drop.tombstones=true and delete.handling.mode=rewrite. Targets Primary Key tables. Supports partial_update and partial_update_mode parameters.
evidence.supports: StarRocks Kafka connector Debezium CDC support and transforms

evidence.snippet: Primary Key tables support UPSERT (default, no __op field) and DELETE (__op=DELETE). Mixed operations use data column 0/1. Partial updates: partial_update=true, row mode and column mode. Missing rows inserted with defaults. Conditional updates via merge_condition since v2.5 — non-PK column condition ensures new data doesn't overwrite older data, designed to resolve data disorder.
evidence.supports: StarRocks PK table updates/deletes, partial update modes, conditional updates for late events

evidence.snippet: Primary Key table uses Delete+Insert strategy realized by primary key index and DelVector. Updates mark original row deleted in DelVector and write latest row to new data file. Only latest record needs to be read during queries — no merge-on-read at query time. 3 to 10 times higher query performance than Unique Key merge-on-read. Primary key values cannot be updated.
evidence.supports: StarRocks PK table Delete+Insert mechanics and performance characteristics

evidence.snippet: Iceberg external catalog supported from v2.4. INSERT INTO from v3.1. Parquet V2: position deletes from v3.1, equality deletes from v3.1.10/v3.2.5/v3.3+. ORC V2: position deletes from v3.0, equality deletes from v3.1.8/v3.2.3/v3.3+. Iceberg views on REST from v3.3.2, on Hive from v3.4.1. Metadata tables from v3.4.1. Time Travel from v3.4.0. Iceberg V3 (deletion vectors) NOT supported per issue #63819.
evidence.supports: StarRocks Iceberg version-specific feature timeline and V3 gap

evidence.snippet: Hudi external catalog from v2.4. Complete support for Copy On Write (COW) and Merge On Read (MOR) tables. Parquet files only (SNAPPY, LZ4, ZSTD, GZIP, NO_COMPRESSION). Read and INSERT INTO supported.
evidence.supports: StarRocks Hudi read support (COW and MOR)

evidence.snippet: Delta Lake catalog from v2.5. Query (SELECT) and load (INSERT INTO) supported. Table features: V2 Checkpoint from v3.3.0, timestamp_ntz from v3.3.1, column mapping from v3.3.6, deletion vector from v3.4.1. No writes TO Delta Lake.
evidence.supports: StarRocks Delta Lake read + load, version-staggered features

evidence.snippet: Resource groups divide each BE into multiple resource sets with cpu_weight (soft), exclusive_cpu_cores/exclusive_cpu_percent (hard isolation since v3.3.5), mem_limit, concurrency_limit. Classifiers match queries by user, role, query_type, source_ip, db, plan costs. default_wg for unmatched queries, default_mv_wg for async MV refresh.
evidence.supports: StarRocks multi-tenant resource isolation and classifiers

evidence.snippet: FE HA: Leader election among Followers. Service stops if majority of Followers fail. Metadata recovery via metadata_ignore_unknown_operation_type=true (downgrade compat) and metadata_enable_recovery_mode=true (damaged metadata). Last resort: bdbje_reset_election_group=true forces node with largest lastVLSN to become Leader. Observers extend read concurrency; queries automatically route to observers for read-only workloads.
evidence.supports: StarRocks HA, follower/observer roles, metadata recovery mechanisms

evidence.snippet: Apache License Version 2.0, January 2004. No dual license terms found in the repository license file.
evidence.supports: StarRocks is Apache 2.0 only, no dual licensing

evidence.snippet: StarRocks is a software licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0. Copyright StarRocks Project a Series of LF Projects, LLC.
evidence.supports: StarRocks confirms Apache 2.0 license on official site

evidence.snippet: Iceberg: core read v3.0+, sinking to Parquet from v3.1+. SHOW CREATE TABLE v3.0+. Position deletes Parquet v3.1, ORC v3.0. Equality deletes Parquet v3.2.5, ORC v3.1.8. Time Travel v3.4.0. Metadata tables v3.4.1. Hudi: complete COW/MOR, Hudi 0.15.0 explicit in v3.5.0. Delta Lake: v3.3.0+ features staggered (checkpoint, column mapping, deletion vector v3.4.1).
evidence.supports: StarRocks lake analytics feature timeline across Iceberg/Hudi/Delta

evidence.snippet: Doris 4.1 adds Iceberg V3 with Deletion Vectors (Puffin) and Row Lineage (_row_id, _last_updated_sequence_number). MERGE INTO and Row Lineage are EXPERIMENTAL. DML requires format-version >= 2. V3 writes require format-version 3 set at creation. REST catalogs recommended; AWS Glue/DLF read-only. Heavy ETL and streaming ingestion out of scope for this DML surface.
evidence.supports: Doris 4.1 Iceberg V3 capabilities and experimental status caveats
